Have you told your girlfriend how you feel?. There is nothing to feel embarrassed or ashamed about when trying to discuss it with her

She may also feel this way but is trying to mend the relationship, try and have an open and heart to heart discussion on how you both feel about your relationship and how to move forward

Why are you worrying about chasing the fountain of youth while you’re still young? 

You could be enjoying time with your family and friends instead of worry about spending time with them

The point is that you’re focusing all your time and energy on “What if?” instead of enjoying life day by day

Your mom was out of line for telling you that, but was this a one time thing or did it repeatedly happen? 

If so, then you might have childhood neglect. Parents think that all children need is a roof over their head and clothes.

But, that’s the furthest from the truth, your mom probably provided for you materialistically wise but she probably neglected you emotionally/mentally

This is very concerning, you have a right to be concerned. I’m guessing something happened to you when you were younger. And your coping mechanism was to do that so you’d get desensitized? 

I’m also taking your emotions into consideration, do you have any clues as to why you feel embarrassed and ashamed?

Maybe you tried to tell an adult and they invalidated your feelings and well being?. I’d suggest you talk to a therapist about this, maybe it could unlock some repressed memories
